notes.title: Project Remedium - Now with Steam cards, badges and backgrounds
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Nano Team![/h1]

We want to communicate that as of today [b]Project Remedium[/b] has Steam cards, badges and backgrounds available for you to unlock. Apart from that, we have prepared some Remedium style emoticons for you to use in chat with your friends. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25854424/c1457f8418ae3dff497377231335d3d48560d3d8.png[/img]

Thank you for all your posts on our steam forum. We encourage you to share your thoughts on how [b]Project Remedium[/b] can be improved by our team.  This will let us know what to focus on first.

Thank you for all your support.
Best Regards,
Atomic Jelly Team

tags.feature: - Apart from that, we have prepared some Remedium style emoticons for you to use in chat with your friends.

notes.title: Update 1.20
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25854424/fcf2f54e078cd7073765a5c2fdb6bad449556744.png[/img]

For quite some time we have been working on needed fixes to the game. It should work better and faster. We are still working on some optimization tweaks so stay tuned. We are very sorry for being so quiet lately. Despite the large amount of work, we have not forgotten about You and we still care and support our nanobots team. You can find a full changelog below.

[h1]
[b]FIX[/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] added caching to the minimap (loading times should go down by a lot)
[*] cached the minimaps on all levels where the they're needed
[*] added new graphic settings to greatly improve gameplay on low spec PCs
[*] fixed broken achievements
[/list]

Cheers,
Atomic Jelly
